description: This file defines the SupplyChainClient class for interacting with the AWS Supply Chain service. It uses PHP and the AWS SDK to provide client methods for managing supply chain resources.

classes.name: SupplyChainClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Supply Chain service, providing methods for creating, deleting, retrieving, listing, sending events, tagging, and updating supply chain resources.
